contrasts.explanation: The catchphrase summarizes the circular-explanation objection developed at E995–E1009 and E1152–E1193. Here A explicitly connects it to an inference from contingent things to an external explanation. Whether that inference succeeds remains disputed; the phrase does not replace an otherwise absent reason.

contrasts.explanation: B distinguishes an unsupported inference about a group from a false conclusion, illustrating the distinction with red bricks and small bricks. The qualification explicitly limits what the composition objection establishes, rather than treating a fallacy label as sufficient disproof.
